purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Rillgate burden-claim fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for contract-hall routine, four evidence filings, the mixed-species seal draw, warranty and conflict pressure, the reserve reckoning, and four state-gated remedy families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the hall establishing view, clerk routine, each branch action that changes evidence or authority, the answering-table draw, the comparison-basin reveal, the reserve threshold, and each ending family. The three-seal draw and the visible reserve arithmetic each receive their own screen.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt states complete visible geometry, camera distance, lighting, bodies, reachable objects and current institutional state. Character refs are assembled only for characters visible in that frame; modifiers carry explicit branch or state deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink linework and restrained watercolor, carved basalt, worn brass, wet wool and colored contract cords, warm amber lamps against pale blue-green mana light, expressive faces and hands, readable silhouettes, humane procedural comedy with serious agrarian stakes, cinematic composition for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every prompt from global_style_cue plus the scene base_image_prompt, then append visual refs only for visible named characters or groups and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Continuity notes stay in tooling. Use a camera-specific render of the declared scene_set map for final multi-angle art.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture revisits one contract hall from counter, wall-cord, bench, locker and wagon-arch angles. Reach, public-versus-clerk sides of the counter, seal seating and custody routes affect branch meaning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For high-consistency website rendering, turn the embedded Rillgate plan into a simple plan view or 3D blockout with the fixed zones, camera slots, sightlines and object states declared below.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a long rectangular contract hall carved from charcoal basalt at a mountain gate. A rain-bright arched wagon entrance fills the west end; a barred brass freight lift fills the east end. A waist-high public counter crosses the center with one lowered section, a shallow brass-rimmed comparison basin and abstract geometric docket marks. Colored contract cords run through stamped metal discs along the south wall: copper braid, blue flax and black horsehair. Three empty stone seal seats stand north of the counter. A bonded iron crystal locker and a smaller brass-bound reserve chest sit against the east wall under amber lamps. Porters and traders queue on wet flagstones near the wagon arch while freight clerks work behind the counter.

visible_characters.default_stance: porters and traders waiting between the rain-bright arch and public counter

visual_continuity_notes: The west wagon arch, center cross-counter, south contract-cord wall, north seal seats and east lift-and-locker wall remain fixed across all cameras.
The lowered counter section gives Pella direct reach to the basin, cords laid across the counter and public docket surface.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium view at the lowered public counter inside the basalt contract hall. Pella Reedbank, a one-meter-tall middle-aged halfling woman with warm brown skin, black curls streaked silver, a mustard wool vest, cream rolled sleeves, rain-dark blue-green cloak and wide mud-stained boots, stands beside a small two-wheel handcart carrying two stoppered green-glass water jars, a swollen leather field book and an oilskin contract packet. Behind the counter Nali Stoneclip, a broad dwarf woman with umber skin, iron-grey hair bound close, square spectacles and a charcoal clerk apron, hangs a fresh stamped date-disc on colored wall cords. Amber lamps warm the wet stone and brass basin between them.

visible_characters.default_stance: at the low counter with both hands near the evidence cart
behind the counter hanging a date-disc on the contract cords

visual_continuity_notes: Pella and her cart remain on the public west side of the counter; Nali remains on the clerk east side unless a later prompt explicitly moves her.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Close-medium evidence-admission frame at the lowered counter. A one-meter-tall halfling woman in a rain-dark blue-green cloak lifts a stoppered green-glass jar of brown irrigation water into a shallow brass cradle; a hair-thin silver root has grown through the cork from inside. A broad dwarf clerk in square spectacles crimps a scratched tin time-strip around the jar neck while three rough-clothed porters witness from the public side. Plain blue-green runes circle the basin, colored contract cords hang on basalt behind the clerk, and the second jar remains on the halfling's handcart.

visible_characters.default_stance: both hands steadying the admitted jar in the basin cradle
crimping the time-strip around the jar neck

The pale crystal locker is visible at the east wall; rain falls beyond the west wagon arch; an amber clock lamp burns lower as the trace consumes the morning.

Waiting traders behind Pella hold parcels and make patient arithmetic with their faces under warm amber lamps.

Pella Reedbank, a short halfling petitioner with muddy boots and evidence cart, stands at the lowered counter; dwarf clerk Nali Stoneclip faces her from the work side. scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide power-geometry frame facing the three stone seal seats north of the public counter. Three Masters take the seats: a flour-dusted dwarf baker in rolled white sleeves, a long-limbed human lift mechanic in a red scarf and work leathers, and a small grey-green goblin chart-printer with long ears and blue-inked fingers; each places a distinct heavy civic seal on stone. At the low counter stands Pella Reedbank, a short brown-skinned halfling woman with silver-streaked curls and evidence cart. Dwarf clerk Nali Stoneclip holds an open bronze draw drum. Master Orik Vane approaches from the east lift, a broad dwarf man in a tailored rust-red coat, silver-clipped red beard and clean gloves. Blue ink also marks two stamped discs on the wall cord behind him.

arriving from the east lift with controlled urgency

visual_continuity_notes: The blue ink connection must be simultaneously visible on the goblin printer's fingers and Orik's custody discs so Pella can plausibly notice it from the low counter.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide final-threshold view from the public counter toward the east wall. Six pale crystal crates sit behind a bonded iron grate. Beside them a much smaller brass-bound reserve chest stands open with only a few clean crystal bars inside. Dwarf clerk Nali Stoneclip chalks two large abstract tally groups on a black slate: nine pump-day marks beside a tiny field symbol and six hoist-day marks beside a lift cage symbol. Pella Reedbank, a short halfling petitioner with evidence cart, faces the three mixed-body Masters and their civic seals. Orik Vane stands between the contract cord and locker. The barred freight lift looms behind the reserve arithmetic under amber and pale blue-green light.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for bodies visible in a scene.

characters.pella_reedbank: Pella Reedbank: halfling woman in early middle age, about one meter tall, warm brown skin, round weathered face, black curly hair streaked silver and pinned loosely, mustard wool vest over cream rolled sleeves, rain-dark blue-green cloak, broad mud-stained boots, sturdy farmer's hands, practical upright posture, often beside a small two-wheel handcart with green-glass jars and a swollen leather field book.
characters.nali_stoneclip: Nali Stoneclip: dwarf woman, about 1.25 meters tall, broad compact build, umber skin, iron-grey hair bound close behind the head, square brass spectacles, charcoal clerk apron over dark wool, chalk stylus and crimping pliers at the belt, economical hand movements and an expression of practiced procedural patience.
characters.orik_vane: Master Orik Vane: dwarf man, about 1.35 meters tall, broad dense build, pale ruddy skin, carefully divided red beard held by two silver clips, tailored rust-red wool coat, cream shirt, polished dark boots, clean grey gloves, open-palmed sales posture that tightens into counting under pressure.

groups.rillgate_drawn_masters: Rillgate drawn Masters: three individual civic sealkeepers on separate stone seats—a broad flour-dusted dwarf baker in rolled white sleeves, a long-limbed dark-skinned human lift mechanic in worn brown work leathers and a red scarf, and a small grey-green goblin chart-printer with long batlike ears, blue-inked fingertips and an indigo printer apron. When recusal is triggered, the goblin stands among witnesses holding the removed seal and a soot-dark dwarf chimneywright in a patched black coat occupies the third seat. Each visible officeholder has one distinct heavy metal civic seal.
groups.rillgate_public_queue: Rillgate public queue: mixed dwarf, halfling, human and goblin porters and traders in wet wool, leather aprons, hooded travel cloaks and work boots, carrying freight hooks, parcel frames, ledgers and handcarts; orderly queue posture near the west wagon arch, with faces shifting from routine patience to attentive public witness.

review_notes: Prompts use affirmative visible descriptions and restate room geometry for every camera-specific base frame.
The embedded scene_set map controls the public and clerk sides of the counter, the blue-ink conflict sightline, the reserve arithmetic sightline and branch-persistent custody states.
A hand-built plan view or 3D blockout remains desirable before high-consistency multi-angle image rendering; image generation is deferred in this pass.
